propertySets.name: Pset_CessBetweenRails
propertySets.definition: Properties in this property set are applicable for IfcSlab with PredefinedType TRACKSLAB, indicated that the slab is a cess or covering between rails.

properties.name: JointRelativePosition
properties.definition: Indicates the relative position of the joint, which lies in the left or right rail or in the middle, or in combination. The left rail is to the left as facing in the direction of increasing stationing values, and the right rail is to the right.

properties.name: CheckRailType
properties.definition: Type of the check rail. Check rail types enumerated in this property are defined based on EN 13674.

properties.name: LoadCapacity
properties.definition: Indicates the highest permissible load capacity.

properties.name: UsagePurpose
properties.definition: The purpose of usage of the cess between rails, e.g. maintenance, rescue services.

propertySets.name: Pset_EmbeddedTrack
propertySets.definition: Properties for track slab that have embedded tracks recessed into road surface.

properties.name: IsAccessibleByVehicle
properties.definition: Indicates whether the element is accessible by a vehicle or not.

properties.name: HasDrainage
properties.definition: Indicates whether the infrastructure element has drainage embedded or not.

properties.name: PermissibleRoadLoad
properties.definition: Permissible traffic load for the road design.

propertySets.name: Pset_SlabTypeTrackSlab
propertySets.definition: Properties in this property set are generally applicable slabs used in railway tracks, modelled as IfcSlab with PredefinedType TRACKSLAB.

properties.name: TechnicalStandard
properties.definition: The technical standard which the element should comply with.
